svg.aria-label: Grant Copilot. Census evidence for grant writers, cited down to the variable. Emory University, 2026. Private repository, demo on request. Business problem: Small nonprofits need quantitative evidence of community need to win grants, but U.S. Census data spans thousands of variables and releases, and few nonprofits have analysts to navigate it. Solution: A grant writer asks a question in plain English and receives a cited narrative of statistics, trends, and peer comparisons, each traceable to a specific Census variable, year, and geography. My contributions: Peer-matching logic across Census releases, multi-year queries, session-aware follow-up questions, redesigned response interface, and export integrity. Built with Python, Gemini / Vertex AI, FAISS, SpatiaLite, Census ACS, Docker.
